item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight across the region, expect mostly cloudy skies with low temperatures ranging from fifty-two to fifty-seven degrees and only a slight chance of precipitation. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy conditions with rain showers likely and high temperatures between sixty-four and sixty-eight degrees, with rainfall amounts generally less than a quarter of an inch. Tomorrow night remains mostly cloudy with lows from forty-five to fifty-three degrees and lingering chances for light rain or patchy fog.
